newsitem.title: USA: U S West sues Washington regulatory group.
newsitem.headline: U S West sues Washington regulatory group.

text.p: U S West Inc and two of its units on Tuesday filed a lawsuit against the Washington Utilities and Transportation Commission (WUTC) claiming a practice called imputaton by local phone companies violates U S West's right to commercial free speech.
The suit, filed in U.S. District Court in Washington, seeks to stop what U S West called "artificial subsidies" of local phone service with advertising revenues from unregulated directory publishing.
The two units involved in the suit are U S West DEX and U S West Communications, the company said in statement.

"We filed suit to stop the Washington Utilities and Transportation Commission from offsetting the costs of providing basic U S WEST Communications phone service with revenues earned by a different company, DEX," said Jim Stever, executive vice president -- Public Policy for U S WEST Inc.
